//: Double-wide openframe user project wrapper hardening (LibreLane 3).
//footprint: Same DESIGN_NAME / DIE_AREA / power pins as the padframe's empty
//footprint2: wrapper, and the same pad-aligned pin template, so the hardened GDS
//footprint3: cell-swaps cleanly into the ../dw_openframe padframe frame.
//flat: user_proj_counter is a plain RTL submodule here, not a MACROS entry:
//flat2: LibreLane 3 synthesizes it flat with the wrapper and self-generates a
//flat3: PDN that reaches the pad-aligned power pins directly (PDN_ENABLE_PINS,
//flat4: the default), so no bridging 'connection' macros are needed either.
//signoff: DRC/LVS signoff is deferred to `cf precheck` (golden sky130 rules,
//signoff2: same as every other project type); Magic/KLayout DRC and Netgen LVS
//signoff3: are disabled here via substituting_steps (no RUN_ gate exists for
//signoff4: them in LibreLane 3). The in-flow Netgen.LVS also false-flags here:
//signoff5: GRT_REPAIR_ANTENNAS inserts extra diodes into the routed layout after
//signoff6: the comparison netlist is written, so some nets end up with more
//signoff7: diodes in the GDS than in the netlist LVS compares against.
//pin-template: Fixed, pad-aligned pin locations (shipped from the padframe
//pin-template2: generator; keep in sync with ../dw_openframe librelane/wrapper/
//pin-template3: pin_template.def) so the wrapper's boundary pins match the frame.
//sparse: Counter example is tiny vs. the 32 mm^2 die. Skip tap/fill so
//sparse2: harden does not insert hundreds of thousands of tap cells, and
//sparse3: keep placement density low so the tiny design stays clustered.
